purpose: Teach: 壁画/シビア/カーナビ/ハッピーエンド/ツイ/奏で/豪雨/南国

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 若い頃、洋館の壁画、見て感動した。
lines.en: When I was young, I saw a mural in a Western-style mansion. It moved me deeply.
lines.style: Measured opening. Quiet nostalgia settling into the voice. Slight pause before 'it moved me' — genuinely remembering the feeling, not performing it. Steady, sparse delivery.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。批評家のシビアな評価、当時、衝撃だったわね。
lines.en: Yes. The critics' harsh judgments back then — they were quite shocking.
lines.style: Soft agreement, almost dreamy. Follows his rhythm naturally. Slight lift on 'harsh' — acknowledging how severe they were. Trails off gently, as if lost in the memory herself.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 今は、カーナビ無しじゃ、運転できないな。
lines.en: These days, I can't drive anywhere without the GPS.
lines.style: Dry, self-aware chuckle in the tone. Light irony — not bitter, just observing his own dependence with gentle humor. Slight shake of the head in the voice.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 昔の映画は、ハッピーエンドが、定番だったわ。
lines.en: Old movies always had happy endings as the standard, didn't they.
lines.style: Wistful, reaching back. Warm undertone of longing for simplicity. Soft finality on the last word — not a question despite the lilt, more a soft statement of what was.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 孫がSNSで、ツイしてくれた、お祝いメッセージ。
lines.en: Our grandchild posted a sweet message on social media for my birthday.
lines.style: Quiet pride breaking through. Warmth on 'sweet message.' Not showy — this is his grandchild, and the gesture moved him in his composed way. Gentle and genuine.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 家の小さなピアノ、お前が奏でる時間、好きよ。
lines.en: That little piano at home — when you play it, I love listening to you.
lines.style: Tender and direct. No performance. This is something she wants him to know. Soft opening, steady through the middle, slight emphasis on 'you' — it's about him, not the piano.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昨夜の豪雨、雨戸閉めて、お互い無事でよかった。
lines.en: Last night's heavy rain — we closed the shutters and we were both safe inside.
lines.style: Reflective, grounded. Small gratitude in the tone. Not dramatic — just the quiet relief of shelter and shared safety. Steady pace, composed but genuine.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: いつか、南国の島で過ごしたいわね。
lines.en: Someday, I'd like to spend time in a tropical place like that.
lines.style: Softly wistful with a hint of warmth. A gentle wish, not urgent. Slight dreaminess on 'tropical place.' Kind of closes the conversation with quiet affection and possibility.
